'''Fudbalski klub Rudar Prijedor''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic alphabet|Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Pудаp Пpиjeдop) is a professional [[association football|football]] club from the city of [[Prijedor]] that is situated in [[Republika Srpska]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]].

Rudar plays in the [[First League of the Republika Srpska]], and the club plays its home matches on the [[Gradski stadion (Prijedor)|Gradski stadion]] which has a capacity that can hold 6,000 spectators."}}
